title: Materials Boundaries observational context v1.3
description: Closed catalog-only source/method families: historical Lee graphene, Bertolazzi monolayer MoS2, Falin monolayer hBN and Ciganas PA12 CF15 tensile summaries. Source-specific dimensions, uncertainty, protocol and selected cells remain separate. No evaluation, temperature-law or cross-family comparison API. Zach/Dudescu annealed PAHT-CF is a separate median/SD source family with contextual SD units.

const.name: Suspended monolayer hexagonal boron nitride
const.preparation: Scotch-tape mechanical exfoliation from high-quality hBN single crystals onto prepatterned SiO2/Si

example_afm_apparent_height.scope: Illustrated 1L BN nanosheet, not effective model thickness and not a sample-distribution mean

defect_status.source_description: high-quality single-crystalline mono- and few-layer BN
defect_status.curation_limit: This is the authors’ specimen characterization, not independent proof that every stressed region or whole sheet is defect-free.

const.processing_vs_testing: Exfoliation/substrate construction describe sample preparation. Literature claims about 800 °C oxidative stability and computational electronic temperature are not indentation test conditions. No anneal or processing temperature is assigned.

notes: Ambient does not establish a numerical temperature, pressure, gas composition or humidity.
The length/time loading velocity is not a membrane strain rate or stress rate.
FEM increment 0.1 nm per step is a numerical discretization parameter, not experimental loading rate.

gaps: Unknown numeric temperature, humidity, pressure and atmosphere composition.
Unknown raw/retained/excluded curve totals, exact failure-event count, parent-flake count and statistical averaging/weighting convention.
Eq. 4 finite-strain stress/strain convention is not explicitly defined in inspected source.
No raw AFM curves, FEM input deck, fit code or independent tip metrology reconstruction available in this batch.
The public peer-review author response supplies SD and sheet-count semantics; the main-text ± notation alone does not.

const: A selected source-reported, model-dependent experimental summary; not a universal material bound, engineering allowable or executable mechanics rule.
N/m is force per length, not a volumetric pressure. No curator 2D/3D conversion or assigned default thickness is admitted.
Stiffness and breaking strength have matching units but are different quantities.
These two property records share one study and are not independent confirmations.
No matched-environment comparison, ranking, composite-evaluator use or volume-fraction overlay is implied.
Monolayer hBN only. Exclude multilayer trends, the paper’s graphene controls, and separate DFT/interlayer/sliding predictions from this small batch.

tip_radii.measurement: Transmission electron microscopy, as reported by authors
tip_radii.locator: Methods > Materials and fabrication; Figure S4 shows 12.6 nm diameter for one tip
tip_radii.curation_limit: These are two reported radii, not a mean plus/minus tolerance. Do not assign one radius to all monolayer tests or treat the 6.3 nm example as every specimen.

const.calibration: Cantilever spring constants determined using combined thermal-noise and Sader methods
const.curve_selection: Fits/calculations retain loading-unloading curves without obvious hysteresis and exclude curves with large hysteresis; exact excluded count and threshold not reported. Relatively large nanosheets used to reduce substrate-slippage error.
const.poissons_ratio_role: Source-adopted hBN model input cited to prior work; not measured for these specimens. Explicitly attached to Eq. 2 fitting discussion.
const.stress_strain_measure_status: Eq. 4 does not explicitly define finite-strain stress/strain measures. Figure 5 labels its strain nominal. Supplement Figure S5 labels its diagnostic maximum Von Mises stress; that neither establishes the volume-averaged strength statistic nor identifies a Cauchy/first-/second-Piola measure. Do not inherit Lee or MoS2 conventions.

effective_thickness_convention.role: Source-used layer thickness for volumetric conversion and finite-element geometry; not the AFM apparent height and not a curator default conversion.
effective_thickness_convention.selected_2d_values_status: Both selected N/m summaries are expressly printed in source; neither is generated by the curator.

const.inference: Fit the loading response with source Eq. 2 to infer E2D and pretension; not a direct uniform tensile-modulus measurement.

model_assumptions: Centrally indented circular isotropic membrane; stiffness fit describes tension/stretching and has no bending term.

ν=0.211 is adopted from cited prior work.

gaps: Neither publisher PDF was inspected; pagination and HTML/PDF equivalence remain unknown.
Raw replicates were not obtained; no raw-data, SD, stress-area, uncertainty-budget or experimental reanalysis.
Engineering versus true stress, area basis and exact UTS extraction method remain unestablished.
SD calculation convention, replicate independence and exclusions remain unverified; SD is not SEM, confidence interval, uncertainty of the median or a bound.
The SD column omits a unit. MPa is a contextual dimensional interpretation from the associated UTS column, and its Pa conversion is conditional on that interpretation.
Direct specimen temperature, calibration, sensor location, tolerance, stability and heating rate are not established.
Actual moisture/RH, batch, measured fiber fraction, crystallinity, density and porosity remain unestablished.
Section 2.2 describes annealing for all specimens while Table A1/Section 2.3 distinguish groups. Only explicitly annealed rows are admitted; untreated history is not inferred.
The 10 mm/s displacement rate is retained as printed, not repaired to mm/min or turned into measured local strain rate.
Source claims of ISO 23529 Type 1, ISO 37 and ISO 527 are not independently verified compliance. Drawing labels are not measured dimensions; central straight length is not assumed gauge length.
The prior 2025 study may overlap non-annealed data. No raw-data overlap audit establishes statistical independence; this admission selects only the newer article’s annealed rows.
Source transcription and software review do not establish independent experimental replication or external scientific validation.
